public interface SignatureAlgorithm
The signature algorithm that implements one TLS signature scheme.

  • Method Details

    • sign

      byte[] sign(byte[] content, PrivateKey certificatePrivateKey) throws InternalErrorAlert
      Signs the given content with the given private key.
      Parameters:
      content - the content to sign
      certificatePrivateKey - the private key associated with the certificate
      Returns:
      the signature
      Throws:
      InternalErrorAlert - when the private key cannot be used with this signature scheme

    • verify

      boolean verify(byte[] content, byte[] signature, PublicKey certificatePublicKey)
      Verifies a signature over the given content with the given public key. Note that this does not check that the public key matches this signature scheme; use keyMatchesScheme(PublicKey) for that.
      Parameters:
      content - the content that was signed
      signature - the signature to verify
      certificatePublicKey - the public key of the certificate that (supposedly) created the signature
      Returns:
      whether the signature is valid
